actual_methods: Independent script; no producer checker execution or import.
Type-sensitive recursive full-document comparison excluding exactly idea.prior_art; separate YAML AST scalar-tag/value comparison; duplicate-key rejection.
Exact parsed lineage mapping comparison and preserved historical search-block checks.
Manual reading of all six bound KR cards and proposal attribution/claim/citation blocks.
Source Git-byte, SHA-256 and reconstructed Git-blob identity checks at base and snapshot; handoff packet hash checks.
Unmodified pinned check_prior_art and real resolver in a scratch tree containing only the six allowed KR cards.
Unmodified registry loader/hash checker/routing in scratch for the two old selected rows and four proposed rows.
38 candidate controls including four expected schema acceptance controls for false semantic claims; eight registry hash controls.
Markdown/SVG/PDF text and rendered one-page PDF inspection.
limitations: Targeted prior-art function only; no full-ledger CLI invocation or current full-corpus result.
Scratch routing only; no live registry application or complete registry validation.
No new primary-literature reading; repository-card source-verification states are reported as recorded.
No validation or replay of experiments, raw outcomes, thresholds, performance, novelty or historical approval.
Exact internal lineage preservation means parsed values, not preservation of raw stanza serialization; original entire source bytes remain unchanged.
No CI, remote reachability or current-head mergeability assessment.
